en.name: Circular Supply Alliance
en.description: A closed corporate challenge for manufacturers and procurement teams building reuse, traceability, and circular-material partnerships between LATAM and China.
en.detailSubtitle: Ideal for companies aligning industrial sustainability goals with real supplier, procurement, and traceability execution.
en.metaTitle: Circular Supply Alliance | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Review Circular Supply Alliance, a corporate challenge for circular manufacturing and traceable supply systems.
en.overviewHtml:
Circular Supply Alliance focused on manufacturers and enterprise operators reducing waste, increasing reuse, and building more transparent materials flows.

The latest cycle is closed, but the challenge remains useful context for companies preparing a stronger sustainability and procurement narrative.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Manufacturers, operators, or technology providers working on circularity, materials reuse, or traceability.
  • Teams with enterprise partnerships or practical deployment pathways.
  • Applicants able to connect sustainability goals to measurable operating outcomes.
en.supportHtml:
• Access to corporate and ecosystem conversations around circular manufacturing.
  • Feedback on procurement, traceability, and operator messaging.
  • Guidance packaging submissions and follow-up materials.
en.processHtml:
1. Prepare through the shared application process for the next cycle.
  2. Submit materials describing the supply challenge, operating model, and traction.
  3. Work with the team to refine the final submission package.

br.name: Circular Supply Alliance
br.description: Um desafio corporativo encerrado para fabricantes e equipes de procurement que constroem reuso, rastreabilidade e parcerias de materiais circulares entre LATAM e China.
br.detailSubtitle: Ideal para empresas que alinham metas de sustentabilidade industrial com execucao real em fornecedores, procurement e rastreabilidade.
br.metaTitle: Circular Supply Alliance | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Veja o Circular Supply Alliance, desafio corporativo para manufatura circular e sistemas rastreaveis de supply chain.
br.overviewHtml:
O Circular Supply Alliance focou em fabricantes e operadores enterprise que reduzem desperdicio, ampliam reuso e constroem fluxos de materiais mais transparentes.

O ultimo ciclo encerrou, mas o desafio segue como boa referencia para empresas que querem fortalecer sua narrativa de sustentabilidade e procurement.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Fabricantes, operadores ou provedores de tecnologia focados em circularidade, reuso de materiais ou rastreabilidade.
  • Times com parcerias enterprise ou caminhos praticos de implantacao.
  • Aplicantes capazes de ligar metas de sustentabilidade a resultados operacionais mensuraveis.
br.supportHtml:
• Acesso a conversas com corporates e ecossistema sobre manufatura circular.
  • Feedback sobre procurement, rastreabilidade e narrativa para operadores.
  • Orientacao para empacotar submissao e materiais de follow-up.
br.processHtml:
1. Prepare-se pelo processo compartilhado para o proximo ciclo.
  2. Envie materiais descrevendo o desafio de supply, modelo operacional e tracao.
  3. Trabalhe com a equipe no refinamento da submissao final.

cn.category: 可持续发展 · 制造业
cn.name: Circular Supply Alliance
cn.description: 一项已结束的企业挑战赛，面向打造材料再利用、可追溯性和循环供应合作的制造与采购团队。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合把工业可持续目标与真实供应商、采购和追溯执行结合起来的企业团队。
cn.metaTitle: Circular Supply Alliance | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 查看 Circular Supply Alliance，这是一项面向循环制造和可追溯供应系统的企业挑战赛。
cn.overviewHtml:
Circular Supply Alliance 聚焦通过减少浪费、提升再利用和透明化材料流动来优化制造运营的企业团队。

最新一期已经结束，但该挑战仍可为准备强化可持续与采购叙事的公司提供参考。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 从事循环利用、材料再用或可追溯性的制造商、运营方或技术提供商。
  • 拥有企业合作基础或明确部署路径的团队。
  • 能够把可持续目标连接到可衡量运营结果的申请者。
cn.supportHtml:
• 参与围绕循环制造的企业与生态交流。
  • 获得关于采购、追溯和运营方叙事的反馈。
  • 帮助整理提交材料和后续跟进内容。
cn.processHtml:
1. 为下一轮开放提前通过统一流程准备。
  2. 提交说明供应挑战、运营模型和牵引力的材料。
  3. 与团队一起完善最终提交包。
